summary.text: Jamie Murphy is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives who has represented the 4th Norfolk District since 2001 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia, which lists him as James Murphy, gives his education as Merrimack College and Suffolk University Law School and his profession as attorney. His professional experience includes work as a Massachusetts Appeals Court attorney and judicial clerk from 1998 to 1999 and as a Suffolk County assistant district attorney from 1999 to 2001.
He has also been a member of the Weymouth Democratic Town Committee.

Murphy took office in 2001 and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026. Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Financial Services Joint Committee for the 2019-2020, 2021-2022, 2023-2024 and 2025-2026 sessions.
